# The Worst Stretch

*Tavi walks the worst stretch of the patrols personally: out along the Broken Ground to the far canyon bridge. Walk it together, look at the bridge, and hunt 60 Dark Axe Stumps on the way.*

## Objectives

1. Defeat 60 [Dark Axe Stump](../monsters/dark_axe_stump.md) in [The Broken Ground](../maps/broken_ground.md)
2. Look at the far canyon bridge in [The Broken Ground](../maps/broken_ground.md)

## Rewards

- 10,750 EXP
- 500 mesos
- [Orange Potion](../items/orange_potion.md) x20
- [Highland Salve](../items/highland_salve.md) x10
- +40 standing with Midbarium
- +30 standing with [Tavi](../npcs/tavi_uskari.md)
